fbd237213c.reason: Tie-break A < B becomes A <= B. Client indices are unique, so the two differ only when the sort compares an element with itself, which Algo::IntroSort never does: its selection sort compares distinct positions (Core/Public/Algo/IntroSort.h:70) and its partition loops exclude the pivot (:98-99); heap-sort comparisons are between distinct nodes [inferred].

0072839e65.reason: Deadline < NextFrameTime becomes <=: no test has a deadline exactly equal to the next frame time, so whether such a client is mandatory is untested.

84989a4f35.reason: SpentMs + Predicted > BudgetMs becomes >=: no test has an update that exactly fills the remaining budget, so the cut-off boundary is untested.

60ff682b30.reason: bOverBudget = SpentMs > BudgetMs becomes >=: no test spends exactly the budget, so 'exactly on budget is not over budget' is untested.
